title: Fetch and AbortSignal
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: A server fetches a slow upstream dependency and ignores cancellation, leaving hung requests and leaking internal error details. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Use Node's standard fetch and AbortSignal.timeout with an explicit HTTP status check; reject unexpected JSON content types before parsing.
Repair node-fetch-abort and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for fetch and abortsignal.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.04 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
